description: Give an agent an ERC-8004 identity on Arc for free. Pass its name, what it does and where it can be reached; we write a correct registration file, host it, check that its endpoints answer, and return the unsigned register() transaction for Arc's identity registry. The wallet that sends it owns the agent from the first block (about 0.004 USDC of gas; one claim from arc_faucet_claim covers it). Then call arc_passport_confirm with the transaction hash. No key ever leaves your side.
